_comment: Global event exclusion filter, applied by pipeline/eventfilter.py AFTER the venue whitelist. Excludes non-crowd listings (facility tours, parking, packages) that Ticketmaster attaches to major venues — without them a daily stadium tour is scored with the venue's full capacity and distorts the verdict. Rules are TM-taxonomy based, so one file covers every configured city. exclude_classifications: an event is excluded if ALL fields in a rule match its first TM classification (case-insensitive; fields: segment, genre, subGenre, type, subType). exclude_name_patterns: case-insensitive substring match on the event name.

exclude_classifications._reason: Venue tours (Rogers Centre Ballpark Tours, Guided Tours of Scotiabank Arena). A handful of visitors walking an empty building, not a crowd event.
